Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary. Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741215', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort: molecule ChEMBL ID ASC, assay ChEMBL ID ASC. Limit: 1000.
sql:
SELECT
  a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM activities act
INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id
INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741215'
  AND act.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, a.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
